name: Aurionpro Solutions Ltd
title: Aurionpro Solutions Ltd - 532668 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue grew 20.2% to INR 1,411 cr with Q4 missed on Middle East and hyperscaler timing; management refuses FY27 growth number while front-loading INR 150-200 cr of development spend and INR 200-250 cr working capital.

capex.quote: we have significantly stepped up both expensed and capitalized investments to meet what we feel are generational opportunities opening up in AI and data centers

triggers.label: No FY27 growth number given
triggers.quote: it would be very unfair for us to throw a half-baked number out because there are uncertainties we don't know

triggers.label: Development spend INR 150-200 cr
triggers.quote: I would think the number is somewhere between 150 and 200 crores over the next four quarters

triggers.label: Working capital INR 200-250 cr
triggers.quote: the INR 200 crores – INR 250 crore sort of number is the right number

triggers.label: Order book 1800 cr, 68-72% executable
triggers.quote: somewhere in the range of 70%-odd, maybe slightly less, let's say between 68 % and 72 %

guidance.value: No number; growth ahead of industry
guidance.quote: we will continue to grow ahead of the industry growth rate
We are not planning on any significant margin dip because the scale of the orders increases.

prior_guidance_check.quote: the revenue actually grew 20.2% to INR 1 ,411 crores
EBITDA margin was 20.02% and PAT margin was 15.02%, we ll within the guided ranges of 20% to 21% and 15% to 16%

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue miss >INR 100 cr; FY27 growth number withheld
red_flags.quote: obviously, you fell more than INR 100 crores short of it

red_flags.label: Front-loaded investment ahead of revenue
red_flags.quote: that investment in your expenses beforehand and then missing the revenue, that is what causes the problem

red_flags.label: Balance-sheet pressure guided for FY27
red_flags.quote: we would rather absorb temporary balance sheet pressure than underinvest

evasions.quote: I am hesitant to throw a planning number out there
I don't see any immediate signs of it
